data.title: Tianshu Deng gave Lulu and Georgia 2 stars. Check out the full review...
data.content:
* * *

![Image 1: Rated 2 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-2.svg)

May 30, 2023

## [Not Presentable as a Gift](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/647614a9706f837cb1f47764)
Bought a vase as a gift. It's cute. But it took 16 days for it to get here. The company didn't send me a shipping notification nor a tracking number. When it finally came, there was no packing list, no gift receipt, no identifying information of any sort. It could have come from anywhere, including the goodwill. It's not quite gift-ready. Wish they had a gift option where something a little more presentable can be included.

May 15, 2023

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

May 31, 2023

Hello Tianshu, thank you so much for your feedback, we have shared this with our teams. Apologies for the inconvenience this has caused. Regretfully, we don’t currently offer gift wrapping or messages with your order, but pricing is never included in the packaging if you’d like to send a gift directly to the recipient.
